title: Sage gameplay_conventions record
description: A gameplay_conventions record (GameplayConventionsRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another gameplay_conventions record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

health.description: The attribute that is an entity's life: when it reaches zero the entity dies. Names a attribute record. Category: Attributes. (RecordRef<AttributeRecord>)

dead.description: The tag a death adds; the dead cannot swing, cast or be chosen as a target. Names a tag record. Category: Attributes. (RecordRef<TagRecord>)

invulnerable.description: The tag the `god` cheat toggles on the local player. Names a tag record. Category: Attributes. (RecordRef<TagRecord>)

damageType.description: The damage type of a hit that names none. Names a damage_type record. Category: Combat. (RecordRef<DamageTypeRecord>)

attack.description: The attack of a fighter that was given none. Names a attack record. Category: Combat. (RecordRef<AttackRecord>)

hitboxBudget.description: Which creatures keep their hitboxes on (issue #273); empty, every creature's are always on. Names a hitbox_budget record. Category: Combat. (RecordRef<HitboxBudgetRecord>)

movement.description: How a character with no movement profile of its own moves. Names a movement_profile record. Category: Profiles. (RecordRef<MovementProfileRecord>)

aiProfile.description: How a creature with no AI profile of its own sees and thinks. Names a ai_profile record. Category: Profiles. (RecordRef<AIProfileRecord>)

playerFaction.description: The faction a player-controlled entity with no faction of its own belongs to. Names a faction record. Category: Factions. (RecordRef<FactionRecord>)

costAttribute.description: The attribute a spell made in the spellmaker costs (mana) Names a attribute record. Category: Abilities. (RecordRef<AttributeRecord>)

surface.description: What ground with no surface, or a surface with no footstep cue, sounds like underfoot (issue #327) Names a physics_material record. Category: Surfaces. (RecordRef<PhysicsMaterialRecord>)

idle.description: Nothing to do: no enemy seen or remembered. Names a ai_schedule record. (RecordRef<AIScheduleRecord>)

chase.description: An enemy seen or remembered, out of reach. Names a ai_schedule record. (RecordRef<AIScheduleRecord>)

meleeAttack.description: An enemy in melee range, and something to swing. Names a ai_schedule record. (RecordRef<AIScheduleRecord>)

castSpell.description: A spell ready and an enemy to throw it at, or a cast under way. Names a ai_schedule record. (RecordRef<AIScheduleRecord>)

holdGround.description: Waiting for a spell to come back, with nothing to swing. Names a ai_schedule record. (RecordRef<AIScheduleRecord>)

attack.description: The button that swings (combat, and the AI's MeleeAttack task) (string)

use.description: The button that uses what is in front of you. (string)

reload.description: The button that reloads: plays the first-person arms' reload and refills the magazine of an attack with `ammo` (issue #135) (string)

attack.description: Obsolete (#119): the clip a sprite fighter with no anim_graph of its own swings with. (string)

hit.description: The clip event that lands a blow (anim_events, a sprite sheet's frame events); without one the attack's windup time does. (string)

idle.description: Obsolete (#119): the clip a sprite fighter with no anim_graph of its own stands in. (string)

attackTrigger.description: The trigger param a swing sets on the fighter's animator when its attack names none (Animators.SetTrigger) (string)

reload.description: The trigger the Reload button sets on the first-person arms' anim_graph (a swing sets `attackTrigger`) (string)

magIn.description: The clip event that puts the magazine in: a reload completes on it, else after the attack's reloadTime (issue #135) (string)
